data.name: Dharmanand
data.gender_notes: Dharmanand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dharmanand is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Dharma' and 'Anand'. Dharma refers to righteousness, truth, and moral duties. Anand signifies bliss, happiness, and joy. Together, this name represents a person who embodies righteousness and experiences immense happiness and joy in life. The name Dharmanand carries the meaning “Dharma (righteousness) and Anand (bliss)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharmanand usually hope their child will grow to embody dharma (righteousness) and anand (bliss) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a strong foundation of righteousness and the pursuit of inner happiness and joy.
data.etymology: Dharmanand belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dharma (righteousness) and Anand (bliss).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharmanand total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Dharmanand was a famous Jain scholar and philosopher of the 12th century AD. He is attributed to have written the commentary on the 'Kalpa Sutra' known as 'Samayasara'. His works significantly contributed to the development of Jain philosophy.

Dharmanand was a king of the Ganga dynasty in the 10th century AD. He ruled over Bengal and Bihar and is known for his patronage of art and culture, particularly Buddhism and Jainism. He is also credited with the construction of several temples and monasteries.
